summary.en: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam said today at the 16th Business of IP Asia Forum that the National 15th Five-Year Plan prioritises innovation and stronger intellectual property protection and utilisation, supporting Hong Kong in deepening its status as an international legal and dispute resolution services centre and a regional IP trading centre; the Chief Executive's Policy Address also commits to developing Hong Kong as a premier regional IP trading hub. Speaking at the breakout session 'Turning Creativity into Economic Value: Clearing Legal Roadblocks in IP Commercialization', Lam cited local cultural and creative industries, noting that film IP can drive tourism — the 'Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In' exhibition turned cultural buzz into economic value — and that the Hong Kong Palace Museum's Ancient Egypt exhibition drew more than 670,000 visitors and spawned about 170 original merchandise items that have generated more than $33 million in revenue for the Museum. The Government introduced the Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Tax Deductions for Intellectual Property Expenditure) Bill 2026 into the Legislative Council last month, and Hong Kong ranks seventh globally in IP rights protection in the World Competitiveness Yearbook 2026.
summary.zh_hans: 律政司司长林定国今日在第16届亚洲知识产权营商论坛分组讨论环节致欢迎辞时表示，国家「十五五」规划重视加快创新及加强知识产权保护和运用，支持香港深化国际法律及争议解决服务中心地位，并发展成为区域知识产权贸易中心；行政长官《施政报告》亦提出全力发展香港成为区内首屈一指的知识产权贸易枢纽。他以本地文化创意产业为例，指电影知识产权可带动旅游，例如《九龙城寨之围城》展览将文化热潮转化为实质经济价值；香港故宫文化博物馆的古埃及文明大展吸引逾67万人次参观，并推出约170款原创商品，有关商品已为博物馆带来逾3,300万港元收入；政府上月已向立法会提交《2026年税务（修订）（知识产权开支税项扣除）条例草案》，香港在《2026年世界竞争力年报》知识产权保障方面全球排名第七。

summary.en: Taiwan's weighted index closed at 36,033 points today, down 2,393 points or 6.23%, its lowest in nearly seven months and the third-largest single-day closing-point drop on record. The index fell as much as 2,688 points intraday, breaking below the 36,000 level, with turnover of NT$877.35 billion. Heavyweight TSMC fell below the NT$2,000 mark intraday to a low of NT$1,970, closing down NT$100 at NT$2,000, a 4.76% drop, while MediaTek and Delta Electronics both hit their daily limits down. The index has fallen 7,641 points, or 17.5%, this week — the largest weekly drop in over 36 years — as the Financial Supervisory Commission's tightened short-selling curbs failed to stem selling that followed the US sell-off and AI-stock worries.

summary.en: The Film Programmes Office of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department will present "Made in Italy – A World of Bittersweetness" from December 13 to January 24 next year, screening 16 Italian films at the Hong Kong Film Archive and K11 Art House. The selection includes the romances "La Dolce Vita", "Girl with a Suitcase" and "Il Bell' Antonio"; class-struggle works "Hands Over the City", "The Conformist" and "Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion"; family dramas "Bicycle Thieves", "The Son's Room" and "Everybody's Fine"; war films "Rome, Open City" and "Life Is Beautiful"; the underworld-themed "The Traitor"; and "Ennio", a documentary on composer Ennio Morricone. All films have Chinese and English subtitles; "The Traitor" is Category III. Tickets are HK$75 at the Film Archive and HK$110 or HK$150 at K11 Art House, with post-screening talks and three seminars.

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan today addressed the first Canadian Indo Pacific Business Summit in Hong Kong, saying the city's economy grew 5.1% over the first nine months — the fastest pace for that period in five years — with goods exports up 30% in the third quarter, private consumption up 2.9% and investment up 7.5%; full-year growth is forecast at 4.8%, underlying inflation at 1.7% and unemployment at 3.8%. In the first 10 months, 121 companies listed in Hong Kong, raising over HK$400 billion. Chan set out three areas for Hong Kong–Canada co-operation: capital — Canada aims to catalyse C$1 trillion of investment at home in five years, while Hong Kong has about HK$42 trillion under management and more than 3,300 family offices; resources — Canada ships about one million tonnes of LNG to Asia a month, while Hong Kong is building gold and commodities trading capacity; and innovation and talent — more than 320,000 people have arrived through talent schemes since the end of 2022. He also noted about 300,000 Canadians live in Hong Kong, and that China and Canada agreed during the APEC meetings in Shenzhen to expand mutual tariff relief and extend their trade arrangement to the end of 2028.
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波今日在首届加拿大印太商业峰会致辞，指出香港经济首九个月增长 5.1%，是五年来同期最快，第三季货物出口升 30%，私人消费升 2.9%，投资升 7.5%；全年增长预测 4.8%，基本通胀 1.7%，失业率 3.8%。首十个月已有 121 间公司在港上市，集资逾 4,000 亿元。陈茂波提出港加三方面合作：资本方面，加拿大目标五年内在当地带动 1 万亿加元投资，香港管理资产约 42 万亿港元，家族办公室逾 3,300 间；资源方面，加拿大每月向亚洲出口约 100 万吨液化天然气，香港正发展黄金及商品交易能力；创新及人才方面，自 2022 年底以来已有逾 32 万人经人才计划来港。他亦提到，约 30 万名加拿大人居港，中加在深圳亚太经合组织会议期间同意扩大关税减免，并将贸易安排延长至 2028 年底。

summary.en: Chief Secretary for Administration Eric Chan Kwok-ki today chaired the first meeting of the Working Group on Coordination of AI Risk Governance, set up under the Policy Address to co-ordinate the AI risk-governance strategy across bureaux. The meeting reviewed work plans for seven specific actions: combating AI-enabled crime, better protecting minor users, market assessment of AI ethical risks, safe and orderly AI use across industries, legal liability for accidents caused by AI products, guidelines on AI-agent management, and AI's impact on employment. Members include the Secretaries for Justice, Education, Financial Services and the Treasury, Innovation and Technology, Labour and Welfare, and Security, the Head of the Chief Executive's Policy Unit and the Commissioner for Digital Policy; the group will meet regularly to oversee implementation. Chan said AI is developing fast and, while it upgrades industry and daily life, risk governance and application safety are equally crucial, with the aim of technology for good that is safe and under control while accelerating AI adoption.
summary.zh_hans: 政务司司长陈国基今日主持统筹人工智能风险管治工作组首次会议。工作组按《施政报告》成立，统筹各局人工智能风险管治策略，会议检视七项具体行动的工作计划，包括打击利用人工智能犯罪、加强保障未成年用户、推动市场评估人工智能伦理风险、推动各行业安全有序应用人工智能、审视人工智能产品引致意外的法律责任、引入人工智能代理管理指引，以及审视人工智能对就业的影响。工作组成员包括律政司司长、教育局、财经事务及库务局、创新科技及工业局、劳工及福利局、保安局局长、行政长官政策组组长及数字政策专员，将定期开会监督落实进度。陈国基表示，人工智能发展迅速，在提升产业及日常生活之余，风险管治及应用安全同样重要，目标是科技向善、安全可控，同时加快应用人工智能。
summary.zh_hant: 政務司司長陳國基今日主持統籌人工智能風險管治工作組首次會議。工作組按《施政報告》成立，統籌各局人工智能風險管治策略，會議檢視七項具體行動的工作計劃，包括打擊利用人工智能犯罪、加強保障未成年用戶、推動市場評估人工智能倫理風險、推動各行業安全有序應用人工智能、審視人工智能產品引致意外的法律責任、引入人工智能代理管理指引，以及審視人工智能對就業的影響。工作組成員包括律政司司長、教育局、財經事務及庫務局、創新科技及工業局、勞工及福利局、保安局局長、行政長官政策組組長及數字政策專員，將定期開會監督落實進度。陳國基表示，人工智能發展迅速，在提升產業及日常生活之餘，風險管治及應用安全同樣重要，目標是科技向善、安全可控，同時加快應用人工智能。

summary.en: Vitasoy International's interim profit for the six months to the end of September rose nearly 8% year on year to HK$185 million, up about 3% excluding currency effects, with an interim dividend of 4 cents per share maintained. Revenue for the half year was HK$3.337 billion, up 3% year on year and down 1% excluding currency effects; gross margin widened 0.8 percentage points to 51.9%, helped by currency movements, lower raw-material costs and improved production efficiency, partly offset by higher trade promotion spending. Mainland revenue rose 5.4% to HK$1.874 billion, with operating profit up 25% to about HK$240 million; Hong Kong revenue was about HK$1.112 billion, broadly flat, with operating profit up 0.7% to nearly HK$140 million. The group expects intensifying price competition, high oil prices and the restructuring of its Australian business to weigh significantly on profitability in the second half.

summary.en: The Health Bureau has announced that Hong Kong, China has formally joined the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH) as a regulatory member, represented by the Hong Kong Pharmacy and Poisons Board. The ICH approved the decision at its assembly in Czechia on November 17, making Hong Kong, China its 20th regulatory member. Hong Kong became an ICH observer on October 31, 2023 and reached full membership in just three years, far faster than the government's earlier estimate of eight to ten years. Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau said membership will help develop Hong Kong's capacity and mechanisms for "first-tier approval" of innovative drugs and deepen participation in setting international rules for drug research and registration. The government will set up a Centre for Medical Products Regulation next month to build independent drug evaluation and approval capability.
summary.zh_hans: 医务卫生局宣布，中国香港正式加入「国际人用药品注册技术协调会」（ICH），成为监管机成员，由香港药剂业及毒药管理局作为代表。ICH 在 11 月 17 日于捷克举行的大会上通过有关决定，中国香港成为第 20 个监管机成员。香港 2023 年 10 月 31 日成为 ICH 观察员，短短 3 年内成为正式成员，较政府早前估算的 8 至 10 年大幅提速。医务卫生局局长卢宠茂表示，有助推动创新药「第一层审批」能力及机制发展，深度参与制定药品研发注册国际规则；政府下月成立药物及医疗器械监督管理中心，建立独立药品审评审批能力。

summary.en: The volume of retired electric-vehicle batteries is expected to rise from about 1,300 tonnes this year to about 6,700 tonnes in 2030. The Environment and Ecology Bureau has submitted a paper to the Legislative Council proposing a producer responsibility scheme for EV batteries, charging EV suppliers a recycling levy based on battery weight, starting at HK$6 per kilogram and rising steadily each year. For a typical private car with a 500-kilogram battery, the starting charge would be about HK$3,000, rising by HK$800 a year to HK$15,000 by 2043. The scheme covers power batteries of battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, including private cars, taxis, motorcycles and electric commercial vehicles other than franchised buses. The government aims to submit an amendment bill to the Legislative Council next year, enter a preparatory phase in 2028 and roll the scheme out fully in 2029. More than 180,000 EVs already distributed before the scheme starts will be exempt, and owners who replace a battery or scrap a vehicle can enjoy one free recycling and vehicle deregistration.

summary.en: Jared Kushner, son-in-law of US President Donald Trump and his special envoy, said Russia has agreed to European participation in a multilateral negotiating mechanism, adding that restarting direct dialogue between Europe and Russia is especially important. A summit of the UK- and France-led "Coalition of the Willing" supporting Ukraine was held in Berlin, where Kushner told a press conference afterwards that Russia could accept Ukraine receiving security guarantees similar to NATO's Article 5 collective defence clause, while also expressing a desire for no new conflict to break out. Kushner stressed that such guarantees would need a mechanism covering monitoring and verification, deterrence and other measures, and that Trump is open to this provided it serves US interests. Neither the United States nor the European Union is a member of the coalition, but special envoy Steve Witkoff, European Council President Antonio Costa, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte also attended. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Europe must be included in the peace talks, and it is not yet clear how NATO Article 5-style security guarantees would work.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普女婿、特使库什纳表示，俄罗斯已同意欧洲参加多边谈判机制，重重启欧洲与俄罗斯直接对话尤其重要。英法牵头、旨在支援乌克兰的「志愿联盟」峰会在德国柏林召开，库什纳在会后记者会上说，俄方能接受乌克兰获得类似北约第五条集体防御条款的安全保障，同时表达不再爆发新冲突的意愿。库什纳强调相关安全保障需要建立涵盖监督核查、威慑等措施的机制，特朗普对此持开放态度，但前提必须符合美国利益。美国及欧盟都不是「志愿联盟」成员，但特使威特科夫、欧洲理事会主席科斯塔、欧委会主席冯德莱恩及北约秘书长吕特亦有出席。乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示欧洲必须被纳入和平谈判，暂时不清楚类似北约第五条的安全保障将如何运作。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普女婿、特使庫什納表示，俄羅斯已同意歐洲參加多邊談判機制，重啟歐洲與俄羅斯直接對話尤其重要。英法牽頭、旨在支援烏克蘭的「志願聯盟」峰會在德國柏林召開，庫什納在會後記者會上說，俄方能接受烏克蘭獲得類似北約第五條集體防禦條款的安全保障，同時表達不再爆發新衝突的意願。庫什納強調相關安全保障需要建立涵蓋監督核查、威懾等措施的機制，特朗普對此持開放態度，但前提必須符合美國利益。美國及歐盟都不是「志願聯盟」成員，但特使威特科夫、歐洲理事會主席科斯塔、歐委會主席馮德萊恩及北約秘書長呂特亦有出席。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基表示歐洲必須被納入和平談判，暫時不清楚類似北約第五條的安全保障將如何運作。

summary.en: All government and aided primary schools will announce on Monday, November 23 the lists of children admitted to Primary One discretionary places for entry in September next year. summary.en: The government plans to set up a Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau, with the Development Bureau submitting a funding paper to the Legislative Council. The bureau follows the government's announcement after the Wang Fuk Court fire that it would be established before the end of the year. The remaining balance of about HK$113 million from the "Bid Smart" scheme will go to the new bureau, on top of HK$300 million earmarked by the government, bringing the total to about HK$413 million. Of that, HK$313 million will fund fee waivers, initially focused on buildings under "Operation Building Bright 2.0", covering about 80% of private residential and composite buildings aged 30 years or more; owners of the remaining 20% of higher-value buildings would pay in full. The bureau aims to complete company registration and appoint its board within next month, with the first case-management team starting work then to contact owners of about 1,800 outstanding maintenance cases under "Bid Smart" that have yet to appoint contractors.

summary.en: The Ministry of Finance issued US$2 billion of sovereign bonds in Hong Kong yesterday, with a three-year tenor and a coupon of 4.821%, all listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The issue drew enthusiastic demand from international investors, with total orders of US$72.3 billion, more than 36 times the issue size. Asian investors accounted for 52%, Europe and the Middle East 34%, and the Americas 14%. The ministry has issued US dollar sovereign bonds in Hong Kong several times since 2017, including a record US$6 billion in 2020 and US$4 billion last November.

summary.en: Hong Kong's two power companies will announce next year's tariff adjustment plans on Tuesday, with the Legislative Council's Panel on Environmental Affairs to first discuss the outcome of the annual tariff review. In November, CLP's average net tariff was 148.6 cents per unit, up about 5.7% from January, while HK Electric's net tariff was 183 cents per unit, up about 12% from January. Both companies said international energy prices remain volatile and they will use prudent procurement and diversified fuel strategies to limit the impact of fuel price swings on customers.

summary.en: The leaders of China, Russia and the United States held a historic meeting yesterday and issued a Peace Declaration, saying the three countries, as permanent members of the UN Security Council, are committed to advancing UN reform. The three countries plan to increase production and supply of refined petroleum products and will hold dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing nuclear proliferation. Scholars said the declaration points the way for UN reform, noting China has long insisted on reform and that, as the influence of different countries has changed greatly since the UN was founded, improving representation will be a key focus. Increasing refined oil supply could bring geopolitical stability and confidence to markets.

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee officiated at the grand opening of the inaugural InfraEX Week 2026, attended by about 800 infrastructure leaders, officials and professionals from more than 30 countries and economies, with about 1,000 more joining online. Lee said Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan, closely aligned with the National 15th Five-Year Plan, provides a strategic roadmap for the city's future. The Northern Metropolis covers one-third of Hong Kong's area and will house about 2.5 million people, create 500,000 jobs and account for about 13% of GDP. The week brings together three concurrent events under the theme "Envisioning a Sustainable Future: From Insights to Impacts".

summary.en: Hong Kong turned markedly colder this morning, with the Observatory recording a minimum temperature of 15.3°C as of 5:30am, the lowest since autumn began. The Observatory issued the Strong Monsoon Signal at 4:45am, with northerly strong winds expected across the territory, averaging more than 40 kilometres per hour and occasionally reaching gale force in gusts. The Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon and a band of cloud and rain are affecting the Guangdong coast, with cloudy skies and a few showers expected today; daytime temperatures in the urban areas will range from 14 to 16 degrees, one or two degrees lower in the New Territories, where some areas and high ground will feel cold. The public is advised to keep warm.
summary.zh_hans: 本港今早天气显著转凉，截至上午5时30分，天文台录得最低气温15.3度，是入秋以来的最低纪录。天文台凌晨4时45分发出强烈季候风信号，预料本港吹偏北强风，平均风速每小时超过40公里，阵风间中达烈风程度。天文台说，一股强烈东北季候风和一道云雨带正影响广东沿岸，预测今日密云，有几阵雨，日间市区气温介乎14至16度，新界再低一两度，新界部分地区及高地寒冷，市民要注意保暖。
summary.zh_hant: 本港今早天氣顯著轉涼，截至上午5時30分，天文台錄得最低氣溫15.3度，係入秋以嚟嘅最低紀錄。天文台凌晨4時45分發出強烈季候風信號，預料本港吹偏北強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。天文台話，一股強烈東北季候風同一道雲雨帶正影響廣東沿岸，預測今日密雲，有幾陣雨，日間市區氣溫介乎14至16度，新界再低一兩度，新界部分地區及高地寒冷，市民要注意保暖。

title.en: Hong Kong ADRs Mostly Lower as HSBC and Xiaomi Fall Nearly 2%; Alibaba Rises After Results
title.zh_hans: 港股ADR大多捱沽 汇控小米跌近2% 阿里绩后造好升逾1%
title.zh_hant: 港股ADR大多捱沽 滙控小米跌近2% 阿里績後造好升逾1%

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks traded in the US as American depositary receipts mostly fell. HSBC and Xiaomi ADRs were down nearly 2% from their Hong Kong closes, equivalent to HK$130.7 and HK$28 respectively, while CCB, Ping An, HKEX and Bank of China ADRs fell nearly 1% or more. Alibaba's ADR rose more than 1% after its results, equivalent to HK$81.7, and JD.com's ADR rose about 2% to HK$100.5.
summary.zh_hans: 港股美国预托证券大多下跌。汇控及小米ADR比本港昨日收市价跌近2%，以港元计，折合报130.7元及28元；建行、平保、港交所、中行ADR跌近1%或以上。阿里巴巴ADR在业绩后造好，升逾1%，折合报81.7元；京东集团ADR亦升约2%，折合报100.5元。
summary.zh_hant: 港股美國預託證券大多下跌。滙控及小米ADR比本港昨日收市價跌近2%，以港元計，折合報130.7元及28元；建行、平保、港交所、中行ADR跌近1%或以上。阿里巴巴ADR喺業績後造好，升逾1%，折合報81.7元；京東集團ADR亦升約2%，折合報100.5元。

title.en: Trump Says He Won't Rush Iran Decision Before New Year as Netanyahu Presses for Decisive Bombing
title.zh_hans: 特朗普：新年前不会仓促决定对伊朗行动 内塔尼亚胡施压促轰炸
title.zh_hant: 特朗普：新年前唔倉促決定對伊朗行動 內塔尼亞胡施壓促轟炸

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has said he will not rush into a decision on the next steps over Iran before the New Year. In a phone interview with US news site Axios on Thursday, Trump said he wanted to see how the situation develops after the New Year. Axios analysed that the timing could mean Trump wants to give the US naval blockade and economic pressure on Iran more time to take effect, and could also signal that, if Iran does not yield before the end of the year, he wants enough time to take military action before the new Democrat-controlled Congress takes office. The report added that Trump faces huge pressure from Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who is urging him to launch a decisive bombing campaign against Iran as soon as possible.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普表示，他不会在新年前就伊朗问题的下一步行动仓促作出决定。特朗普星期四接受美国新闻网站阿克西奥斯电话访问时说，要看看新年之后局势如何发展。阿克西奥斯分析，特朗普提及的时间节点可能意味，他希望为美国对伊朗实施的海上封锁和经济施压行动留出更多时间以发挥作用，亦可能表明，如果伊朗今年年底前不让步，特朗普希望在由民主党掌控的新一届国会正式履职前，为自己留出足够的时间来采取军事行动。报道又说，特朗普面临来自以色列看守政府总理内塔尼亚胡的巨大压力，内塔尼亚胡敦促他尽快对伊朗发动一场决定性的轰炸行动。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普表示，佢唔會喺新年前就伊朗問題嘅下一步行動倉促作出決定。特朗普星期四接受美國新聞網站阿克西奧斯電話訪問嗰陣話，要睇吓新年之後局勢點樣發展。阿克西奧斯分析，特朗普提及嘅時間節點可能意味，佢想畀美國對伊朗實施嘅海上封鎖同經濟施壓留多啲時間發揮作用，亦可能表明，如果伊朗喺年底前唔讓步，特朗普希望喺民主黨掌控嘅新一屆國會正式履職之前，留返足夠時間採取軍事行動。報道又話，特朗普面對以色列看守政府總理內塔尼亞胡嘅巨大壓力，內塔尼亞胡敦促佢盡快對伊朗發動一場決定性轟炸行動。

title.en: US Stocks Plunge Over 2% as Dow Loses 50,000; Anthropic Jumps 17% on Debut
title.zh_hans: 美股急挫2%以上 道指失守5万点 Anthropic首日挂牌劲升17%
title.zh_hant: 美股急挫2%以上 道指失守5萬點 Anthropic首日掛牌勁升17%

summary.en: US stocks closed sharply lower, with all three major indices down more than 2%, as Anthropic's first day of trading failed to lift the market and AI shares came under broad pressure. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell below 50,000 for the first time since June, closing near its low of the day at 49,097, down 1,101 points or about 2.2%, its fourth straight daily loss and its lowest close in more than six months. The S&P 500 fell for a sixth straight day to 7,175, down 147 points or 2%, its lowest in nearly seven months, while the Nasdaq dropped 550 points or nearly 2.3% to 23,879, its lowest in more than seven months. Anthropic's listing is the largest IPO in history by fundraising size; its shares peaked at US$115.1, nearly 39% above the US$83 offer price, with its market value briefly topping US$2 trillion, before closing at US$97.17, up more than 17% on the day. Nvidia fell more than 3% to US$145.98, its sixth straight decline and its first close below US$150 in about a year and a half, while AMD fell nearly 8% after being targeted by a short seller, having dropped more than 11% at one point.
summary.zh_hans: 美股三大指数收市急挫2%以上，Anthropic首日上市都未能提振大市，AI股份普遍受压。道琼斯指数失守5万点关口，是6月以来首次，以近全日低位收市，收报49097点，跌1101点，跌幅约2.2%，连跌4日，创逾半年收市新低。标普500指数连续6日低收，收报7175点，跌147点，跌幅2%，创近7个月低位；纳斯达克指数收报23879点，跌550点，跌幅近2.3%，是逾7个月以来最低。Anthropic挂牌是历来最大集资规模的首次公开发售，股价高见115.1美元，较上市定价83美元高近39%，市值一度突破2万亿美元，收报97.17美元，全日升逾17%。Nvidia收报145.98美元，跌逾3%，连跌6日，是近一年半以来首次在150美元以下收市；AMD被沽空机构唱淡，最多曾跌逾11%，收市跌近8%。
summary.zh_hant: 美股三大指數收市急挫2%以上，Anthropic首日上市都未能提振大市，AI股份普遍受壓。道瓊斯指數失守5萬點關口，係6月以嚟首次，以近全日低位收市，收報49097點，跌1101點，跌幅約2.2%，連跌4日，創逾半年收市新低。標普500指數連續6日低收，收報7175點，跌147點，跌幅2%，創近7個月低位；納斯達克指數收報23879點，跌550點，跌幅近2.3%，係逾7個月以嚟最低。Anthropic掛牌係歷來最大集資規模嘅首次公開發售，股價高見115.1美元，較上市定價83美元高近39%，市值一度突破2萬億美元，收報97.17美元，全日升逾17%。Nvidia收報145.98美元，跌逾3%，連跌6日，係近一年半以嚟首次喺150美元以下收市；AMD被沽空機構唱淡，最多曾跌逾11%，收市跌近8%。

title.en: Putin Rules Out Maritime Ceasefire Talks After Kerch Bridge Hit Three Days Running, Vows Stronger Russian Response
title.zh_hans: 克里米亚大桥三日连遭袭击 普京：不再谈海上停火 俄方回应将更强硬
title.zh_hant: 克里米亞大橋三日連環遇襲 普京：唔再談海上停火 俄方回應更強硬

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has said that, after the Kerch Bridge was attacked again, Russia will not negotiate a maritime ceasefire or a halt to attacks on energy facilities with the relevant parties. Putin stressed the bridge is a civilian facility and Russia has never used it to transport military equipment, ammunition, oil or petroleum products. He said Russia had assessed the possibility of talks, but after the latest attack it will not negotiate, and its response will be stronger than Ukraine's attacks. Russian media reported the bridge has been attacked for three consecutive days, disrupting traffic. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Ukrainian forces used drones and Neptune missiles to strike the bridge's road and rail facilities.
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯总统普京表示，克里米亚大桥近日多次遇袭后，俄方不会就海上停火或停止攻击能源设施与有关方面谈判。普京强调，大桥是民用设施，俄方从未通过大桥运输军事装备、弹药、石油及石油制品；俄方曾经评估谈判的可能性，但大桥再次遇袭后不会再谈，俄方将作出回应，而且力度将比乌方的攻击更大。俄罗斯传媒报道，大桥连续三天遭到乌军袭击，交通受到影响；乌克兰总统泽连斯基证实，乌军使用多款无人机和“海王星”导弹，对大桥的公路和铁路设施实施打击。
summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯總統普京表示，克里米亞大橋近日多次遇襲後，俄方唔會再就海上停火或者停止攻擊能源設施同有關方面談判。普京強調，大橋係民用設施，俄方從來冇經大橋運送軍事裝備、彈藥或者石油產品；俄方曾經評估過談判嘅可能性，但大橋再次遇襲之後唔會再談，俄方將會作出回應，而且力度會比烏方嘅攻擊更大。俄羅斯傳媒報道，大橋連續三日遭到烏軍襲擊，交通受到影響；烏克蘭總統澤連斯基證實，烏軍用多款無人機同「海王星」導彈，打擊大橋嘅公路同鐵路設施。

title.en: Trump Heads Home After China Visit, to Hold White House Press Conference Friday on Thailand and Philippines Trade Deals
title.zh_hans: 特朗普结束访华回国 周五白宫开记者会 谈泰菲贸易协议
title.zh_hant: 特朗普結束訪華回國 周五白宮開記者會 談泰菲貿易協議

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has ended his visit to China and returned home, posting on social media that the visit was very good and far-reaching. He said he will hold a press conference at the White House at noon on Friday, where he will also discuss trade deals with Thailand, the Philippines and other countries. During the APEC summit in Shenzhen, Trump held trilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, covering the Ukraine crisis, preventing nuclear proliferation, the Middle East and the Korean peninsula, followed by a peace declaration. After the talks, Trump travelled by motorcade to Bao'an International Airport and flew out on Air Force One; Foreign Minister Wang Yi saw him off at the airport.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普结束中国访问行程回国，他在社交平台发文，形容今次访问非常好和影响深远；他星期五中午会在白宫召开记者会，届时亦会讨论与泰国、菲律宾及其他国家的贸易协议。特朗普在深圳出席APEC峰会期间，与国家主席习近平及俄罗斯总统普京举行三方会谈，讨论乌克兰危机、防止核武器扩散、中东局势和朝鲜半岛等问题，会后发表和平宣言。三方会谈结束后，特朗普乘坐专车前往宝安国际机场，再登上空军一号专机启程离开，外长王毅到机场送行。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普結束中國訪問行程回國，佢喺社交平台發文，形容今次訪問非常好同影響深遠；佢星期五中午會喺白宮召開記者會，屆時亦會討論同泰國、菲律賓及其他國家嘅貿易協議。特朗普喺深圳出席APEC峰會期間，同國家主席習近平及俄羅斯總統普京舉行三方會談，討論烏克蘭危機、防止核武器擴散、中東局勢同朝鮮半島等問題，會後發表和平宣言。三方會談結束後，特朗普乘專車前往寶安國際機場，再登上空軍一號專機離開，外長王毅到機場送行。

title.en: Houthi Attack Damages Saudi Arabia's Tallest Building in Riyadh, No Casualties Reported
title.zh_hans: 胡塞武装袭击利雅得 沙特最高建筑多层受损 无人伤亡
title.zh_hant: 胡塞武裝襲擊利雅得 沙特最高建築多層受損 無人傷亡

summary.en: Saudi Arabian authorities have said the tallest building in the capital Riyadh was attacked by Yemen's Houthi forces, damaging multiple floors and nearby buildings, but causing no casualties. The Saudi Civil Defence said on Thursday it condemned the attack on civilian facilities as a blatant violation of international humanitarian law. Photos attached to the statement show the building hit was the Public Investment Fund Tower in the King Abdullah Financial District, currently the tallest building in Riyadh.
summary.zh_hans: 沙特阿拉伯当局表示，首都利雅得最高建筑遭到也门胡塞武装袭击，多个楼层和周边建筑受损，但未造成人员伤亡。沙特民防总局星期四发表声明，谴责袭击针对民用设施，公然违反国际人道法。声明附有的图片显示，遇袭建筑是位于利雅得阿卜杜拉国王金融区的公共投资基金大厦，是利雅得目前最高的建筑。
summary.zh_hant: 沙特阿拉伯當局表示，首都利雅得最高建築遭到也門胡塞武裝襲擊，多個樓層同周邊建築受損，但未造成人員傷亡。沙特民防總局星期四發表聲明，譴責襲擊針對民用設施，公然違反國際人道法。聲明附有嘅圖片顯示，遇襲建築係位於利雅得阿卜杜拉國王金融區嘅公共投資基金大廈，係利雅得目前最高嘅建築。

title.en: Mongolian Parliament Approves President Khurelsukh's Resignation With 96 Votes in Favour, a First for a Sitting President
title.zh_hans: 蒙古总统闪辞获国会通过 96票赞成 创史上首位在任总统提前下台
title.zh_hant: 蒙古總統閃辭獲國會通過 96票贊成 創史上首位在任總統提前下台

summary.en: Mongolia's parliament has voted to approve President Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh's resignation, with 96 of the 104 voting members backing the motion. It is the first time in Mongolia's history that a sitting president has voluntarily stepped down early. Under the constitution, the parliament speaker will act as president until a new president is sworn in, and parliament must call a presidential election within four months. Khurelsukh, elected in 2021, announced his resignation on November 17. He has denied allegations of abuse of power and corruption, saying he made no policy mistakes and never took state or public property.
summary.zh_hans: 蒙古议会召开全体会议，表决批准总统呼日勒苏赫辞去总统职务。投票的104名议员中，96人投赞成票，今次是蒙古历史上首次有现任总统主动提前辞职。根据蒙古宪法规定，总统自愿辞职后由议会主席代行总统职权，直至新总统宣誓就职；议会须在4个月内宣布并举行总统选举。呼日勒苏赫2021年当选总统，本月17日宣布辞职。针对外界流传的滥用职权、贪腐敛财等指控，他表示自己并未犯下任何政策性错误，亦未窃取过国家和人民的财产。
summary.zh_hant: 蒙古議會召開全體會議，表決批准總統呼日勒蘇赫辭去總統職務。投票的104名議員中，96人投贊成票，今次是蒙古歷史上首次有現任總統主動提前辭職。根據蒙古憲法規定，總統自願辭職後由議會主席代行總統職權，直至新總統宣誓就職；議會須在4個月內宣布並舉行總統選舉。呼日勒蘇赫2021年當選總統，本月17日宣布辭職。針對外界流傳的濫用職權、貪腐斂財等指控，他表示自己並未犯下任何政策性錯誤，亦未竊取過國家和人民的財產。

title.en: Danish Parliament Approves Greenland Defence Deal Letting US Set Up New Defence Areas and Expand Military Operations
title.zh_hans: 丹麦议会通过格陵兰防卫协议 美国可设新防务区扩大军事行动
title.zh_hant: 丹麥議會通過格陵蘭防衛協議 美國可設新防務區擴大軍事行動

summary.en: Denmark's parliament has passed a security and defence agreement covering Greenland, its autonomous territory. Signed in September this year by Denmark, Greenland and the United States at the United Nations headquarters in New York, the deal revises the 1951 US-Denmark defence agreement, allowing the US to set up new defence areas in Greenland, upgrade facilities and expand military operations. It will take effect once Denmark and Greenland complete their parliamentary approval procedures and the US receives the relevant diplomatic note; Greenland's parliament already passed the agreement on November 3.
summary.zh_hans: 丹麦议会表决通过一项涉及丹麦自治领地格陵兰岛的安全与防卫协议。相关协议今年9月由丹麦、格陵兰岛与美国在纽约联合国总部签署，修订美国与丹麦1951年签署的防务协定，允许美国在格陵兰岛设立新的防务区域，以及升级相关设施和扩大军事行动。根据协议，丹麦和格陵兰岛完成议会审批程序后，协议将在美方收到相关外交照会后生效。格陵兰自治议会已经在本月3日通过协议。
summary.zh_hant: 丹麥議會表決通過一項涉及丹麥自治領地格陵蘭島的安全與防衛協議。相關協議今年9月由丹麥、格陵蘭島與美國在紐約聯合國總部簽署，修訂美國與丹麥1951年簽署的防務協定，允許美國在格陵蘭島設立新的防務區域，以及升級相關設施和擴大軍事行動。根據協議，丹麥和格陵蘭島完成議會審批程序後，協議將在美方收到相關外交照會後生效。格陵蘭自治議會已經在本月3日通過協議。

summary.en: TVB's 59th anniversary gala, "TVB Anniversary Gala", was held at Television City on the evening of November 19, with more than 200 artistes taking part. Headline performer Andy Hui, appearing in the same event as Kenneth Ma for the first time since the 2019 "On Sum" incident seven years ago, said neither of them felt awkward; Ma was not seen on stage while Hui performed, avoiding a shared frame, and only reappeared for the grand prize draw at the end. Roger Kwok led more than 170 artistes in the opening song-and-dance numbers "Kei Gor" and "Old Time Buddy", revealing numbness in the sole of his right foot and saying he will seek further checks and acupuncture. In the "Tung Cheung Goddess Cup" 400-metre race, Samantha Lee won in 1 minute 25 seconds, followed by Hilary Lei and Ting Yan Chan. summary.en: Hong Kong Customs yesterday detected a case in which a local company conducted a cash transaction for a watch containing precious metals and stones valued at over HK$120,000 without being a Category B registrant under the Dealers in Precious Metals and Stones Regulatory Regime; the investigation is ongoing. Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, anyone carrying on a business dealing in precious metals and stones with transactions totalling HK$120,000 or more must register with Customs; a non-Category B registrant carrying out a cash transaction of HK$120,000 or more commits an offence punishable by a maximum fine of HK$100,000 and six months' imprisonment. Customs reminded dealers they must obtain registration before carrying out any cash or non-cash transaction of HK$120,000 or more.
summary.zh_hans: 海关昨日侦破一宗贵金属及宝石交易商案件，一间本地公司在未成为B类注册人下，以现金交易一只价值逾12万港元、含贵金属及宝石的手表，调查仍在进行中。根据《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集条例》，从事贵金属及宝石交易、总值12万港元或以上的交易须向海关注册；非B类注册人进行12万港元或以上现金交易即属违法，一经定罪最高可罚款10万港元及监禁六个月。海关提醒交易商，进行12万港元或以上现金或非现金交易前必须先取得相关注册。
summary.zh_hant: 海關昨日偵破一宗貴金屬及寶石交易商案件，一間本地公司在未成為B類註冊人下，以現金交易一隻價值逾12萬港元、含貴金屬及寶石的手錶，調查仍在進行中。根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》，從事貴金屬及寶石交易、總值12萬港元或以上的交易須向海關註冊；非B類註冊人進行12萬港元或以上現金交易即屬違法，一經定罪最高可罰款10萬港元及監禁六個月。海關提醒交易商，進行12萬港元或以上現金或非現金交易前必須先取得相關註冊。

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks fell for a fourth consecutive day to their lowest in more than a year and a half. The Hang Seng Index fell more than 530 points intraday to 22,307 before closing at 22,410, down 430 points or 1.89%, with main-board turnover of nearly HK$270.3 billion. The Tech Index fell nearly 5% intraday before closing at 3,511, down 3.78% and at a more than two-year low. Most ATMXJ stocks fell 1% to 3%, but Alibaba rose more than 3% after better-than-expected results, the best performer among Hang Seng and Tech constituents; Kuaishou and NetEase fell more than 11% and nearly 18% respectively after results, the worst two constituents. The Hang Seng is down nearly 5.2% this week and the Tech Index nearly 8%.

summary.en: The Census and Statistics Department said today that the Composite Consumer Price Index rose 2.2% year on year in October 2026, up from 1.9% in September, mainly because the rates concession ended in September. Netting out the effects of the Government's one-off relief measures, underlying inflation was 2.0%, slightly below September's 2.1%. By component, electricity, gas and water rose 12.7%, miscellaneous services 5.0% and transport 4.5%, while basic food fell 0.8%; the CPI(A), CPI(B) and CPI(C) rose 2.0%, 2.2% and 2.3% respectively. In the first 10 months of 2026, the Composite CPI rose 1.8% over the same period a year earlier.
summary.zh_hans: 政府统计处今日公布，10月综合消费物价指数按年升2.2%，升幅较9月的1.9%扩大，主要因为差饷宽免于9月结束。扣除政府一次性纾缓措施影响，基本通胀率为2.0%，略低于9月的2.1%。按类别计，电力、燃气及水升12.7%，杂项服务升5%，交通升4.5%，基本食品跌0.8%；甲类、乙类及丙类消费物价指数分别升2%、2.2%及2.3%。今年首十个月合计，综合消费物价指数按年上升1.8%。

summary.en: The Northern Metropolis Development Ordinance was gazetted today. The Ordinance provides the legal basis for facilitation measures covering town planning, land compensation, building works approvals, noise control and cross-boundary flows, to speed up development and help enterprises set up in the Northern Metropolis. The Legislative Council passed the bill at its third reading on November 12. The Development Bureau is preparing the first batch of subsidiary legislation for LegCo vetting in January, to take effect in the first quarter of 2027. The Northern Metropolis will be developed as a university town and innovation and technology hub, and as Hong Kong's main platform for engaging in Greater Bay Area development and integrating into national development.
summary.zh_hans: 《北部都会区发展条例》今日刊宪。条例为多项便利措施提供法律基础，涵盖城市规划、土地补偿、建筑工程审批、噪音管制及便利跨境人流，以加快发展及建设步伐，协助企业落户北都。立法会已于11月12日三读通过条例。发展局正制定首批附属法例，争取明年1月提交立法会审议，并于明年首季生效。北都将以大学城、创科、产业及宜居宜业宜游为发展目标，成为香港深度参与大湾区建设及融入国家发展的主要平台。

summary.en: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said today at the luncheon session of the 2nd International Infrastructure and Projects Leaders Summit that Hong Kong ranks second globally in the IMD World Competitiveness Ranking, and the Northern Metropolis will provide about 900 hectares of spade-ready sites, over 70,000 residential units and one million square metres of new economic floor space in the coming five years. The Government is also promoting construction technology and artificial intelligence applications, targeting an annual reduction of over 10% in public works construction costs and savings of HK$12-15 billion over the coming few years, and developing the Centre of Excellence for Major Project Leaders into a Belt and Road capacity-building platform. The summit also marks the opening of the inaugural InfraEX Week 2026.
summary.zh_hans: 发展局局长甯汉豪今日在第二届国际基建及项目领袖峰会午餐会致辞时表示，香港在国际管理发展学院世界竞争力排名全球第二，北都将在未来五年提供约900公顷熟地、逾70,000个住宅单位及100万平方米经济楼面面积。政府亦正推动建筑科技及人工智能应用，目标每年减低公共工程造价逾一成，未来数年节省120亿至150亿港元，并把大型项目领袖卓越中心发展为「一带一路」能力建设平台。是次峰会亦是首届InfraEX Week 2026的开幕活动。

summary.en: The Hospital Authority and the Fire Services Department announced today that the Pre-hospital Stroke Diversion Scheme will extend from the New Territories to all districts in Kowloon and Lantau Island from 8.30am on November 23. Ambulance personnel who assess a patient as having a suspected large vessel occlusion stroke will convey the patient directly to a designated hospital in the service catchment area, eliminating interhospital transfer time. The scheme was first launched on December 15 last year in the New Territories East and West clusters, and as at August 31 this year 145 patients with suspected large vessel occlusion stroke had been conveyed directly to Prince of Wales Hospital and Tuen Mun Hospital, with the average time from ambulance departure to treatment shortened by about 80 minutes per patient. After the extension, patients will be taken directly to Princess Margaret Hospital, Queen Elizabeth Hospital or Kwong Wah Hospital according to their district.
summary.zh_hans: 医管局及消防处今日宣布，院前中风分流计划将于11月23日上午8时30分起，由新界扩展至九龙及大屿山所有地区。救护人员评估病人疑似大血管闭塞中风后，会直接将病人送往所属服务范围内的指定医院，免却转院时间。计划去年12月15日先在新界东及新界西医院联网推行，截至今年8月31日，已有145名怀疑大血管闭塞中风患者直接送往威尔斯亲王医院及屯门医院，每名病人由救护车出发至接受治疗的平均时间缩短约80分钟。扩展后，病人会按地区直接送往玛嘉烈医院、伊利沙伯医院或广华医院。
summary.zh_hant: 醫管局及消防處今日宣布，院前中風分流計劃將於11月23日上午8時30分起，由新界擴展至九龍及大嶼山所有地區。救護人員評估病人疑似大血管閉塞中風後，會直接將病人送往所屬服務範圍內的指定醫院，免卻轉院時間。計劃去年12月15日先在新界東及新界西醫院聯網推行，截至今年8月31日，已有145名懷疑大血管閉塞中風患者直接送往威爾斯親王醫院及屯門醫院，每名病人由救護車出發至接受治療的平均時間縮短約80分鐘。擴展後，病人會按地區直接送往瑪嘉烈醫院、伊利沙伯醫院或廣華醫院。

summary.en: The Housing Bureau said today the latest Composite Waiting Time for Subsidised Rental Housing is 4.4 years, down 0.4 years from 4.8 years at the end of June and below 4.5 years for the first time, hitting a 10-year low. Compared with the 6.1-year peak before the current-term Government took office, it is 1.7 years shorter. The figure is the average waiting time of general applicants housed to public rental housing or Light Public Housing in the 12 months to end-September 2026. The bureau said it is confident of meeting the target of reducing the waiting time to 4.5 years in 2026-27. About 11,200 general applicants were housed in the third quarter of 2026, and average public housing production over the next five years will exceed 35,000 units a year, up about 73% and the highest in 25 years. As at end-September 2026, there were about 96,100 general applications for public rental housing, down nearly 40% from the peak of 156,400 in September 2020, a 15-year low and the first time the figure has fallen below 100,000 since 2012.
summary.zh_hans: 房屋局今日公布，最新公屋综合轮候时间为4.4年，较今年6月底的4.8年大幅缩短0.4年，首次跌穿4.5年，创十年新低；与本届政府上任前最高的6.1年相比，缩短了1.7年。轮候时间以截至今年9月底过去12个月获编配公屋或简约公屋的一般申请者平均轮候时间计算。房屋局表示有信心达到2026-27年度将轮候时间降至4.5年的目标。2026年第三季约有11,200名一般申请者获编配公屋或简约公屋；未来五年每年平均提供逾35,000个公营房屋单位，较过去五年增加约73%，为25年来最高。截至今年9月底，公屋一般申请约96,100宗，较2020年9月高位156,400宗下降近四成，创15年新低，亦是自2012年以来首次跌破10万宗。
